description.value: Intrigue Wines is a boutique, family-owned winery in Lake Country, BC, founded in 2008 by two local families who combined winemaking, business, and community expertise to build an award-winning Okanagan estate. All wines are crafted from 100% BC-grown grapes with sustainability at the core, earning consistent recognition for quality across white, red, rosé, and sparkling styles. Cyclists riding the Okanagan Wine Route can drop in for a bookable tasting experience or pick up bottles at the on-site wine shop in a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was fully fetched and corroborates all OSM contact details: phone 250-980-3233, address 2291 Goldie Rd Lake Country BC V4V 1G5, and the website URL all match. The site confirms an active boutique winery with an on-site wine shop and tasting bookings, open daily. No cycling-specific amenities (bike racks, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those are null per evidence-only rules; the wine shop selling bottles constitutes takeout evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Intrigue Wines is an established, award-winning boutique winery on Lake Country's Okanagan Wine Route — a well-known cycling destination — making it a natural and valuable stop for touring cyclists seeking local wine tastings and take-home bottles.
